'''Warhammer Quest: The Adventure Card Game''' is a cooperative dungeon crawl for one to four players. The [[TCGMix]] playtest includes the tutorial, ''An Uneasy Alliance'' campaign and ''Lost in the Dark'' delve, with companion bots for empty seats.<ref name="catalog" />
